
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /subagent  (/sub)                          │
  │  Sub-agent Settings                         │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Manage the sub-agent model and instruction profiles.

  Usage:
    /subagent
    /subagent model
    /subagent profiles
    /subagent create
    /subagent status
    /subagent show [id]
    /subagent edit [id]
    /subagent delete [id]
    /subagent run [profile] [task]

  Details:
    Sub-agents use their own saved provider and model, separate from
    your main model. The selection survives /clear, restarts, and
    /switch, and only you can change it — the agent cannot.
    
      • (no args)   — Open the sub-agent menu
      • status      — Show the saved model and available profiles
      • model       — Choose and save the sub-agent provider/model
      • profiles    — List capability profiles and their limits
      • create      — Add instructions on top of a locked profile
      • show/edit/delete — Manage one custom profile
      • run         — Run one task under a profile
    
    Every action works with no arguments: leaving an id or profile
    out opens a picker instead of printing usage.
    
    Capability profiles decide what a sub-agent may do. Custom
    instructions refine behaviour but can never add tools or
    widen permissions.

  Examples:
    $ /subagent
    $ /subagent model
    $ /subagent run review check auth.py for missing validation

  Tips:
    Tip: Sub-agents never get delegate_task, so they cannot spawn more sub-agents.

  Related: /background  /settings
